description: This file declares an interface for reading and retrieving various details related to savings accounts within the Fineract platform, including account data, transactions, account status, and external identifiers.

classes.name: SavingsAccountReadPlatformService
classes.description: This interface defines the contract for services that provide read-only access to savings account data, including retrieval of all accounts, specific account details, transactions, and status-based account lists.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of savings accounts based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves all savings account data for a specific client for lookup purposes.

methods.name: retrieveActiveForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves active savings accounts for a client, filtered by deposit account type, with an overload that also filters by currency code.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific savings account by ID.

methods.name: retrieveDepositTransactionTemplate
methods.description: Returns a deposit transaction template for a specific savings account and deposit type.

methods.name: retrieveAllTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions for a savings account and deposit type.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves a specific savings account transaction by transaction ID and deposit type.

methods.name: retrieveForLookup
methods.description: Retrieves savings accounts for a client, optionally filtering by overdraft status.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsIdsPendingInactive
methods.description: Gets IDs of savings accounts pending inactivation as of a specified date.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsIdsPendingDormant
methods.description: Gets IDs of savings accounts pending dormancy as of a specific date.

methods.name: retrieveSavingsIdsPendingEscheat
methods.description: Gets IDs of savings accounts pending escheatment as of a specific date.

methods.name: isAccountBelongsToClient
methods.description: Checks if a savings account belongs to a given client, considering account type and currency.

methods.name: retrieveAccountNumberByAccountId
methods.description: Fetches account number by account ID.

methods.name: getAccountsIdsByStatusPaged
methods.description: Retrieves account IDs with a particular status in a paginated manner.

methods.name: retrieveAllSavingsDataForInterestPosting
methods.description: Retrieves savings data suitable for interest posting, with filters for backdated transactions and status.

methods.name: retrieveAllTransactionData
methods.description: Retrieves transaction data for a list of reference numbers.

methods.name: retrieveAccountIdByExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves an account ID based on an external ID.

methods.name: retrievePeriodicAccrualData
methods.description: Retrieves accrual data for a savings account up to a specified date.
